meta.title: Knee Ligament & Cartilage Injuries | Cambridge Hospital
meta.description: Restoring knee stability and mobility for a confident return to activity.

overview: Knee ligament injuries, including ACL, PCL and MCL tears, and cartilage damage require carefully structured rehabilitation to restore stability, strength and full range of motion.

At Cambridge Hospital, our outpatient knee rehabilitation programme delivers progressive strengthening, neuromuscular retraining, proprioceptive exercises and sport-specific conditioning. Both conservative and post-operative pathways are managed by experienced physiotherapists with clear milestones throughout recovery.
